digest.component_or_area: scripts import convention and test isolation
propositions: Bare `import alert_dedup` in scripts/canary_bridge.py and scripts/dependency_audit.py fails with ModuleNotFoundError when test file runs in isolation, because the import relies on scripts/ being on sys.path only via process-wide side effect from tests/scripts/conftest.py
Full test suite passes in CI because sys.path insertion at collection time leaks across all modules in session, masking the defect that appears in subset runs

The fix pattern uses explicit sys.path.insert of the script's own directory derived from __file__, idempotent and invocation-independent, already established in scripts/jira_dc_epic_link_clear_probe.py

New guard test tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py AST-scans scripts/ for bare sibling imports and verifies each is preceded by required sys.path insert, plus subprocess check that affected test modules collect standalone
